# Rumbletect

> Rumbletect is a browser app that designs the continuous sound of jets, rockets, and eruptions from their physics. A scene places jets, singly or in formation, and airliners on flight paths or rockets, singly or as a launcher's salvo, on an ascent from a launch pad, or eruption jets from a volcanic vent, sustained or in Strombolian bursts, and microphones in 3D over level ground, and renders what each microphone hears: jet mixing noise in two components with their spectra and directivity, or a rocket plume's sound power with SATURN's spectrum and frequency-dependent directivity, carried with delay, spreading, Doppler shift, air absorption, ground reflection, and turbulence. It is a creative tool for sound design: a result is a plausible flyover, not a measurement, and levels are uncalibrated model values in pascals.

Rumbletect runs entirely in the browser, with no account and no server of its own. Every part of the model is marked A (first principles), B (literature), or C (heuristic or synthetic). It belongs to the tect family with Boomtect and Echotect and shares Boomtect's interface.

Wavefronts and Mach cones show propagation geometry with indicative, source-independent brightness. Emissions along each source path form one outer boundary, joining the initial front and supersonic propagation. Interior cone lines are hidden by the same reached volume. Rocket origins follow the acoustic plume positions; the volcano front originates at the same effective height as its audio grains. These visuals do not display sound level.

Exports are 32-bit float WAV at one full scale in pascals, recorded in the scene JSON; per-microphone files start at the same moment. A scene is JSON with `"format": "rumbletect.scene"` and opens again as a scene. A scene reader fills in missing fields with defaults and never refuses an older or newer version.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/janne-s/Rumbletect/blob/main/README.md): what every control does and the model table with sources and classes
- [Live app](https://janne-s.github.io/Rumbletect/)

## Formats

- [Scene](https://github.com/janne-s/Rumbletect/blob/main/src/domain/scene.js): every parameter with its default and range
- [Constants](https://github.com/janne-s/Rumbletect/blob/main/src/domain/constants.js): the model's tuning values and limits

## Optional

- [Boomtect](https://janne-s.github.io/Boomtect/llms.txt): lightning, blasts, and sonic booms
- [Echotect](https://janne-s.github.io/Echotect/llms.txt): echoes from buildings, streets, and terrain
